capabilities.title: Web-based KeePass-compatible password manager (offline-first PWA)
capabilities.sourceEvidence: KeeWeb: browser-based KDBX reader with offline-first design
capabilities.reason: Nexus is not a password manager. KeeWeb's core product is outside scope.

capabilities.title: Offline-first PWA pattern: full functionality without network access, local-first sync
capabilities.sourceEvidence: KeeWeb offline-first design: works fully in airplane mode, syncs opportunistically
capabilities.reason: Nexus is a PWA; KeeWeb's offline-first sync pattern (service worker + indexed DB caching) is a useful reference for improving Nexus offline capability.

capabilities.title: WebDAV and Dropbox sync for vault files across devices
capabilities.sourceEvidence: KeeWeb sync providers: WebDAV, Dropbox, Google Drive
capabilities.reason: Nexus data sync uses git; third-party file sync providers are outside scope.

capabilities.title: Plugin architecture for extending KeeWeb with custom features
capabilities.reason: Nexus skills system is the extension point; a formal plugin architecture with versioned API is pending.
